26:207.text: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.

26:208.text: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners

26:209.text: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.

26:210.text: And the devils have not brought it

26:211.text: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.

26:215.text: to those who follow you of the believers.

26:216.text: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."

26:217.text: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

26:218.text: Who sees you when you arise

26:219.text: And your movement among those who prostrate.

26:220.text: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

26:221.text: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?

26:222.text: They descend upon every sinful liar.

26:223.text: They pass on what is heard,
and most of them are liars.

26:225.text: Do you not see that in every valley they roam

26:226.text: And that they say what they do not do? -

26:227.text: who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allāh often and defend
after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what
